_readme: Hand-curated ownership for widely read outlets. MBFC's dataset has no ownership column, so these entries fill the Source tab's Parent Company / ownership type for the outlets readers see most. Keyed by the outlet's registrable domain. ownershipType must be one of: Corporate Chain, Independent, State-Affiliated, Foundation-Funded, Religious Organization. Compiled by the authors from public company information (company 'about' pages, annual reports); re-verify against Media Ownership Monitor / the outlet's own disclosure before the defense, and edit this file freely. Run `node scripts/enrich-outlet-metadata.js <path to mbfc-data.json>` after editing.

nypost.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by News Corp, the media group controlled by the Murdoch family. Sister outlets include The Wall Street Journal and The Times (UK).

wsj.com.ownershipDetail: Published by Dow Jones & Company, a subsidiary of News Corp (Murdoch family).

foxnews.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by Fox Corporation, controlled by the Murdoch family.

thesun.co.uk.ownershipDetail: Published by News UK, the British arm of News Corp.

cnn.com.ownershipDetail: Part of Warner Bros. Discovery, a publicly traded media conglomerate.

nytimes.com.ownershipDetail: Publicly traded; voting control is held by the Ochs-Sulzberger family trust.

washingtonpost.com.ownershipDetail: Privately owned by Jeff Bezos through Nash Holdings since 2013.

usatoday.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by Gannett, the largest US local newspaper chain.

latimes.com.ownershipDetail: Privately owned by Patrick Soon-Shiong since 2018.

nbcnews.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by NBCUniversal, a subsidiary of Comcast.

abcnews.go.com.ownershipDetail: ABC News is part of Disney Entertainment, The Walt Disney Company.

cbsnews.com.ownershipDetail: CBS News is owned by Paramount, the parent of the CBS network.

npr.org.ownershipDetail: Non-profit public media organization funded by member stations, donations, sponsorships and foundation grants.

pbs.org.ownershipDetail: Non-profit membership organization of US public television stations.

apnews.com.ownershipDetail: A not-for-profit news cooperative owned by its member newspapers and broadcasters.

reuters.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by Thomson Reuters, majority-controlled by the Thomson family's Woodbridge Company.

bloomberg.com.ownershipDetail: Privately held; majority owned by Michael Bloomberg.

politico.com.ownershipDetail: Acquired by the German publisher Axel Springer in 2021.

businessinsider.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by the German publisher Axel Springer since 2015.

thehill.com.ownershipDetail: Acquired by Nexstar Media Group in 2021.

time.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by Marc and Lynne Benioff since 2018.

vox.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by Vox Media, a privately held digital media company.

theatlantic.com.ownershipDetail: Majority owned by Emerson Collective, founded by Laurene Powell Jobs.

motherjones.com.ownershipDetail: Published by a non-profit foundation; funded by readers and donors.

theintercept.com.ownershipDetail: Non-profit news organization funded by First Look Institute and reader donations.

breitbart.com.ownershipDetail: Privately held; run by CEO Larry Solov.

dailywire.com.ownershipDetail: Privately held; co-founded by Ben Shapiro and Jeremy Boreing.

newsmax.com.ownershipDetail: Publicly traded; founder and CEO Christopher Ruddy is the controlling shareholder.

oann.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by Herring Networks, a privately held company.

theguardian.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by the Scott Trust Limited, which exists to secure the paper's editorial independence.

dailymail.co.uk.parentCompany: DMG Media (Daily Mail and General Trust)
dailymail.co.uk.ownershipDetail: Owned by DMG Media, controlled by the Harmsworth/Rothermere family.

bbc.com.ownershipDetail: A public corporation established by Royal Charter, funded mainly by the UK television licence fee and editorially independent of government.

aljazeera.com.ownershipDetail: Funded by the government of Qatar.

dw.com.ownershipDetail: Germany's international public broadcaster, funded by the federal budget.

france24.com.ownershipDetail: Publicly funded French international broadcaster, owned by the French state.

abs-cbn.com.ownershipDetail: Owned by ABS-CBN Corporation, controlled by the Lopez family.

inquirer.net.ownershipDetail: Published by Philippine Daily Inquirer, Inc., controlled by the Prieto family.

philstar.com.ownershipDetail: Published by Philstar Global Corp., associated with the Belmonte family.

rappler.com.ownershipDetail: Independent Philippine digital news company co-founded by Maria Ressa.
